positive_checks: 3 acquisition integration tests passed; whole crucible-search crate reported 19 tests passed across 4 suites, including existing V5-21 reference controls.
Largest-remainder allocation is deterministic for odd batches; proposal IDs are unique and accepted cost never exceeds the supplied budget.
Audit draws cover low-ranked strata, estimate recall/rank disagreement with Wilson intervals, charge audit cost in the result, and deny pruning when audit budget fails.
Failed resolution/rotation/gap challenges quarantine dependent claims and pin a regression ID; frozen epoch coordinate/crosswalk/policy changes are rejected.

Independent and sandbox prior/pruned-input namespaces remain separate; grouped holdouts exclude shared geometry and preparation; held-out calibration and prediction checks abstain for insufficient coverage, OOD and unsupported geometry.
negative_controls: Recipe-prior origin and pruned raw input cannot enter the independent-label dataset; sandbox prior remains separately named.
Duplicate proposals do not duplicate selection; unaffordable proposals do not overcommit budget.
High elite correlation cannot override a failed audit budget or low recall lower bound.
Unsupported geometry and changed policy epoch/crosswalk are rejected; predicted metrics are not inserted into qualified archive by these APIs.
limitations: Software controls only; no physical or scientific PASS and no admitted independent labels are supplied.

crucible-search has no joil-evidence dependency. EV-09/EV-12 readiness, live evidence references, revocation dependencies and reviewer decisions must be verified upstream; dataset intake flags alone are not evidence authority.
Audit cost is exposed in AuditResult but integration must charge it to every experiment-arm ledger.
The exploit challenge evaluates supplied resolution/rotation/gap outcomes; native geometry or solver challenge execution is outside this packet.
V5-04, V5-15, V5-17 and V5-21 dependency acceptance remains an integrator decision.
next_dependency: Integrate with upstream joil-evidence admission and per-arm audit ledger, then use source-bound independently qualified labels for calibration; retain direct evaluation until then.
